scope: ROUTE EXPLORATION ONLY for the rank-deficient part of the codimension-m coarea critical set. NO THEOREM WAS PROVED, no library module was added and no existing .lean file was modified. Deliverables: an exact localization of the obstruction, an honest search of Mathlib and this repository, a numbered obligation list with exact Lean statements, line estimates and risk, and the check-only file research/audits/RankDeficientRouteStatements.lean. A PROPOSITION THAT TYPE-CHECKS IS NOT A PROOF: none of the fifteen propositions is proved anywhere in this repository. Not extended to Sard. No hole migrated. The log-concave Cheeger-Buser line belongs to collaborator Wang Haocheng and was not touched.

obstruction.stratification: the coarea critical set is {x | rank (fderiv u x) < m}, stratified as Sigma_r = {x | rank (fderiv u x) = r} for r < m; the proved vanishing-derivative result is exactly the layer r = 0
obstruction.why_the_proved_method_stops_at_r_zero: the approximating partition's linear models are values of the derivative; on Sigma_0 they vanish, the linear part drops out and u is genuinely epsilon-Lipschitz on each piece. For r >= 1 the derivative does not vanish and u is not Lipschitz-small in any direction inside the range of Du.
obstruction.wrong_exponent: projecting onto the m - r surviving directions does make Q . u epsilon-Lipschitz on the pieces, but the Eilenberg bound then reads integral over tau of mu_H[d] (S inter {Q.u = tau}) <= C * eps^(m-r) * mu_H[d + (m-r)] S, so a finite right-hand side for S of positive Lebesgue measure forces d + (m-r) = n, that is d = k + r. The conclusion is mu_H[k+r]-nullity, and a mu_H[k+r]-null set can have infinite mu_H[k]: the wrong direction. This is route statement N1.
obstruction.infinite_right_hand_side: insisting on d = k instead puts mu_H[k + (m-r)] S = mu_H[n-r] S on the right, which is infinity for every r >= 1 as soon as S has positive Lebesgue measure, so the bound is vacuous. This is route statement N2.
obstruction.conclusion: no single slicing works at any exponent; the slicing must be iterated

route.idea: slice first along the r directions in which the differential is already surjective, then apply the Eilenberg bound inside a fibre along the m - r surviving directions
route.step_one: with W1 the range of the differential at a point of Sigma_r and P, Q the orthogonal projections onto W1 and its orthogonal complement, v = P . u is a submersion near that point, so the PROVED regular coarea formula coarea_of_contDiffOn_of_coareaJacobian_ne_zero applies and its fibres carry finite H^(n-r) measure
route.key_linear_algebra: on the stratum P is injective on the range of Du, so ker (P . Du) = ker (Du) and the differential vanishes along the fibre directions; hence Q . u has vanishing derivative along the fibre
route.step_two: inside a fibre the Eilenberg bound is used with d = k and target of dimension m - r, and d + (m - r) = k + m - r = n - r is exactly the dimension in which the fibre has finite measure
route.recombination: Fubini across the orthogonal splitting of the target turns 'for almost every s, for almost every tau' into 'for almost every t'
route.technical_point_found_this_round: a chord of a fibre is not a tangent vector: two points in the same fibre of P . u only give ||P A (b-a)|| <= ||P|| eps ||b-a||, and converting that into smallness of ||A (b-a)|| needs a norm bound on a right inverse of P . A, uniform over the neighbourhood because every scale of the eps -> 0 limit uses a different partition

mathlib_search.coarea: NO coarea formula anywhere in Mathlib (repository-wide search for 'coarea' has zero hits)
mathlib_search.constant_rank: NO constant-rank theorem; the only 'constantRank' occurrences are in RingTheory and are unrelated to submersions
mathlib_search.sard: only the equidimensional Sard lemma addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_det_fderivWithin_eq_zero in MeasureTheory/Function/Jacobian.lean, plus two dense-complement statements in Topology/MetricSpace/HausdorffDimension.lean that give density, not nullity
mathlib_search.rank_semicontinuity: isOpen_setOfPred_nat_le_rank in Analysis/Normed/Module/FiniteDimension.lean gives openness of {f | r <= rank f}, which is exactly what the stratification needs
mathlib_search.approximates_linear_on: exists_partition_approximatesLinearOn_of_hasFDerivWithinAt gives the approximation and a countable disjoint measurable partition and NOTHING about rank; ApproximatesLinearOn.antilipschitz needs the linear model to be an equivalence and does not apply when the model is rank-deficient. What that line can supply is exactly the input of obligation R4, no more and no less.
mathlib_search.orthogonal_splitting: Submodule.orthogonalDecomposition, LinearIsometryEquiv.measurePreserving and WithLp.volume_preserving_ofLp are all present, so obligation R6 has all its parts

obligations.content: TARGET: the rank-deficient critical set is H^k-null in almost every level
the rank strata are measurable and the critical set is their finite union over r < m
kernel lemma: on the stratum the differential vanishes along the fibre of the regular part
approximate right inverse of a surjection, pointwise and locally uniform
the tangential small-Lipschitz estimate on fibres: the new analytic content and the single point of no return
the fibres of the regular part carry finite H^(n-r) measure at almost every level
Fubini across the orthogonal splitting of the target
the local per-stratum slicing: assembly of R1-R6
localization of a local null-slicing statement to a global one
the consumer: the codimension-m coarea formula with no dichotomy hypothesis
the equidimensional degenerate case n = m, from Mathlib's equidimensional Sard lemma
diagnostic: the wrong exponent the one-step method yields
diagnostic: lowering the exponent makes the right-hand side infinite

explicitly_not_recommended_now: do not start with R7: it depends on all five earlier obligations and would only produce a skeleton full of sorry

do not count R10 as progress on the rank-deficient part: it is cheap and can stand as an audit witness, but the equidimensional Sard lemma says nothing about the intermediate ranks, which are the whole difficulty
do not attempt any Sard theorem: this route targets null critical SLICES and asserts nothing about the measure of the set of critical VALUES, which for a merely C1 map may well be positive
do not attempt the full degenerate Federer coarea formula or C1 Morse-Sard in one go
do not touch the log-concave Cheeger-Buser line (Wang Haocheng), sharp finite-regularity Sard, or the five Energy holes
why_nothing_was_proved: R10 is genuinely cheap, but proving it into the library needs a new library module, and a new module must join the aggregate import in formalization/FunctionalInequalities.lean to be covered by the default lake build, which would mean modifying an existing .lean file. This round was instructed not to. R10 is therefore recorded as cheap-but-unproved rather than smuggled in.

route_statement_file.disclaimer_in_header: a proposition that type-checks is not a proof

route_statement_review.new_observation_not_an_error: A5 carries the same mu_H-against-Lebesgue pairing as the falsified A0, but A5 is an implication whose proof is countable additivity and is therefore normalization-agnostic, so A5 is NOT falsified; only its conclusion is the literally false A0, so its hypothesis is unsatisfiable in that normalization. Recorded, file not modified.

scalar_consistency: for m = 1 non-surjective and zero are the same condition for a real differential, so the rank-deficient part is EMPTY and R0 degenerates to the already proved scalar L10; the route adds nothing and claims nothing new in codimension one

boundary_cases_in_the_statements.zero_dimensional_target: R0 needs no positivity of the codimension: with finrank W = 0 every linear map into W is surjective, the critical set is empty and R0 is vacuous rather than false, so the hypothesis was deliberately NOT imposed
boundary_cases_in_the_statements.zero_dimensional_ambient_space: forced to be zero-dimensional as well by k + finrank W = finrank V with finrank W = 0, and covered by the same vacuous branch
boundary_cases_in_the_statements.no_finiteness_hypothesis: R0, R1, R2, R3, R4, R8 and R9 assume no finiteness; R5 assumes relative compactness because that is exactly what makes the fibre measure finite, and N1 assumes mu_H[n] S finite because the majorants of the disjoint pieces have to add up
boundary_cases_in_the_statements.r_equal_m_in_N1: 0 < finrank W2 is a real hypothesis of N1: with r = m there is no direction left to project onto, the Eilenberg constant is eps^0 = 1 and the statement is false
boundary_cases_in_the_statements.R7_only_reaches_points_of_the_stratum: at a point of lower rank no fixed rank-r projection works however close the stratum comes; R8 only has to cover the set being sliced, so this is enough

audit.reason: the round proved nothing, so there is no new declaration to audit and no new axiom report
